en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style image showing a dramatic sunset scene over a river. In the foreground, a long passenger steamboat moves along the water. In the background, on a hill, there is a dark silhouette of a large complex with multiple spires and towers, strongly suggesting a historic cathedral and castle complex. Thick clouds are illuminated from behind by the setting sun, creating a high-contrast sky. A German caption appears at the bottom.
